lesson.title: Python and Django Fundamentals and Project Setup
lesson.description: In this lesson, students will learn the basics of Python programming and how to set up a Django project. They will then write their first Django application and understand the structure of a Django project, laying a strong foundation for future development work.

subtopics.title: Configuring Virtual Environment and Installing Dependencies
subtopics.description: Learn how to set up a virtual environment for your Python project and install necessary dependencies using pip. Understand the importance of a virtual environment in managing project-specific libraries and dependencies, and how to manage them efficiently with pip.

subtopics.title: Creating and Configuring a Django Project
subtopics.description: Discover how to create a new Django project, configure settings, manage databases, and set up middleware and authentication. Explore the structure and purpose of each configuration file.

lesson.title: Advanced Django: Form Handling, Authentication, and API Integration
lesson.description: This lesson further explores advanced topics in Django, focusing on form handling, user authentication, and integrating with external APIs. Students will also learn about testing and deployment strategies to enhance their Django applications.

subtopics.title: Advanced Form Handling in Django
subtopics.description: In this section, we will delve into advanced form handling techniques in Django, including custom form validation, formsets, and form wizards. Understanding these features will allow you to create more robust and user-friendly forms within your Django applications.

subtopics.title: Secure Authentication and Authorization in Django
subtopics.description: This part of the lesson will focus on secure user authentication and authorization mechanisms in Django. We will cover topics such as custom user models, session management, password hashing, and implementing role-based access control. Ensuring security is crucial in any Django application, and this section will equip you with the knowledge to protect your users and data effectively.
